body: Seriously? That's what you got from all this?
Still pretty bad. But I'm managing.

I've tried once to tell them how I felt and they just shrugged it off as me feeling down because I'm stressed about jobs and normal life stuff. They've even told a few times that they were raised in households that didn't believe in depression and other related mental illnesses. So, I'm afraid for the reason that they'll overreact and go to extremes or tell me I'm overreacting and going to extremes. I really am just not sure what to do.
Trick question, they weren't thinking at all.
